Python console, saved macros, command recording and the portable QuantityDriver proxy are available from the buttons. Python tracing has a two-second budget; native calls may take longer. The API browser covers available App/Base bindings. The native Part API is available when the Original Part runtime is loaded. Arbitrary addon proxy classes and Gui bindings remain pending.

Only whitelisted Part primitives/features/booleans and App metadata documents can be restored here. Native Sketcher sketches are now supported. PartDesign and other workbench documents remain pending."

"Independent native Android CAD app with selected FreeCAD functionality.

Native ARM64 OpenCASCADE 7.9.2 CAD kernel; actual FreeCAD PlaneGCS Sketcher solver; software 3D renderer, optional OpenGL ES 3, and Android touch UI.

New: weighted NURBS control points, interpolated splines, profiles, loft/sweep/revolve/extrude, sections, offsets, chamfer, healing, jewellery settings, bounded subdivision primitives and a small typed node graph.

The optional document lab includes original FreeCAD Base/App/Part/Materials, native parametric solids and booleans, dimensional expressions, transactions, bounded geometry preview, STEP exchange, Python console/macros and one portable scripted metadata feature. Native FCStd restoration is limited to documented App metadata and whitelisted Part types. Sketcher, PartDesign, Gui and arbitrary workbench/addon FCStd support remain pending. The new Part runtime still requires Android execution testing. The main CAD workspace keeps its independent OCCT recipe engine. STEP transfers solid geometry to desktop FreeCAD.

All work is local. The app requests no network permission.

Code: LGPL-2.1-or-later. FreeCAD: LGPL-2.1-or-later. OpenCASCADE: LGPL-2.1 with OCCT exception. Eigen: MPL-2.0. Boost: Boost Software License 1.0. meshoptimizer: MIT. Optional lab: Qt6.8.3 LGPL3/GPL3 notices and CPython3.13 PSF licence. Full notices accompany the source bundle and are included in app assets."
